vetSays.line: 🛡️ the person in their 40s, Dorothy, the person in their 50s, with deep-set eyes and Vsevolod met them at the door — 4 put down. the person in their 40s, Dorothy, the person in their 50s, with deep-set eyes, Vsevolod are hurt.
🛡️ Dorothy, Alex, Vsevolod and Florencia met them at the door — 4 put down. Dorothy, Alex, Vsevolod are hurt.
🛡️ Alex, Vsevolod, Florencia and Fatima met them at the door — 4 put down. Alex, Vsevolod, Florencia, Fatima are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dale just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Dorothy, Alex and Florencia met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Dorothy, Alex, Florencia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dale just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Alex just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Dorothy, Alex, Florencia and Fatima met them at the door — 4 put down. Dorothy, Alex, Florencia, Fatima are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nino just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Onni just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jesse, Henry and James met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Jesse, Henry, James are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wei just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
